Araquanid

Water Bug

Alola · Generation 7

Araquanid is a Water/Bug-type Water Bubble Pokémon first found in Alola (Generation 7). It stands 1.8 m tall and weighs 82 kg. It evolves from Dewpider. Its highest base stat is Sp. Def (132), with a base stat total of 454.
